panels.beat: Crowded Golden City, only elves; no identifiable Lolth
panels.text: The Golden City could no longer shelter all its people.

panels.beat: Elven council; no identifiable Lolth
panels.text: The great families would leave, each seeking a new home for the elves.

panels.beat: Thalestriel departure, more than one hundred elves and open relic wagon
panels.text: Lolth: Eol, damn you. You have driven us from our home.

panels.beat: Creature attack on the travelling family
panels.text: Lolth: Curse you, Eol! Must your creatures hunt us too?

panels.beat: Hostile attackers, family protecting the relic wagon
panels.text: Lolth: Damn you, Eol. Every road becomes another trap.

panels.beat: Natural disaster strikes the caravan
panels.text: Lolth: Eol, you bastard! Even the land turns against us.

panels.beat: Plague takes hold; Lolth remains unaffected
panels.text: Lolth: Curse you, Eol. Now you send sickness after them.

panels.beat: Most of the caravan lost, non-graphic mourning
panels.text: Lolth: Damn you, Eol. I will not leave the others behind.

panels.beat: Damaged wagon and exactly eight plagued elves lying inside the cave, with Lolth
panels.text: Lolth: Curse you, Eol. We are still here, and we stay together.

panels.beat: Shar appears after Antlered Hunger is defeated
panels.text: Shar: Every calamity reaches your family. None touches you. Who are you?

panels.beat: Lolth's former godhood presented as a memory, not a new divine identity design
panels.text: Lolth: I remember another plane. There, I was a goddess.

panels.beat: Lolth offers the memories; Shar accepts
panels.text: Lolth: Take those memories. Give me a path to power and divinity here. Shar: Agreed.

panels.beat: Shar applies the Shadow Mark with her wand
panels.text: Shar: Receive the Shadow Mark.

panels.beat: Fully clothed elf-to-drow transformation
panels.text: The bargain remade Lolth as a drow.

panels.beat: Wand handed to Lolth, restrained shadow-creature command cue
panels.text: Shar: THE KISS OF SHAR is yours. Its bearer can command all shadow creatures.

panels.beat: Lolth completes her established final transformation
panels.text: Lolth's transformation was complete.

panels.beat: Portal opens to the Dream Plane
panels.text: She opened a passage to the Dream Plane.

panels.beat: Lolth and exactly eight drows cross with the open wagon and relics
panels.text: All nine crossed together. No one, and no relic, was left behind.

panels.beat: All nine remain together in the Golden City of Dreams
panels.text: In the Golden City of Dreams, they found their home.

panels.beat: Lolth leaves the wand in the eight drows' collective custody and stays with them
panels.text: THE KISS OF SHAR remained in the eight drows' care. Lolth remained with them.
